entries: May I explain how Triple Battles work?

Triple Battle is a battle format in which
each side uses three Pokémon.{VAR BE01}
A Trainer who makes all of the opponent's
Pokémon faint will win.

This doesn't intrigue you? It's fun.
Please allow me to explain how it works.
